theme: Light theme preferred. Medical applications require high trust, cleanliness, and clear readability. The 'Organic & Earthy' archetype is chosen to create a reassuring, grounded experience avoiding clinical sterility.

headings.strategy: Approachable yet authoritative. Use tracking-tight for all headings. DO NOT use generic sans like Inter for headings.

body.strategy: High legibility, especially optimized for biometric data, charts, numbers, and medical reports.

colors.strategy: Avoid standard 'SaaS blue' or clinical sterile palettes. Ground the user with warm sand tones and deep forest green. Use terracotta for missed dose alerts or critical vitals.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism for health data to prevent visual refraction of crucial medical information. Use crisp 1px borders (border-[#E5E4E2]) with subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm).
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded-xl for main data cards, pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary call-to-action buttons. Ensure concentric nested radii.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for standard dashboard navigation, dependents avatars, and actions. NEVER use emojis as icons.
visual_enhancers.header: Solid or semi-solid background (e.g., bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with border-b. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) for Doctor Portal and Patient Dashboard. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Span primary charts across 2-3 columns.
grids_and_layouts.landing: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8) for marketing sections.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision and provide breathing room.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (e.g., translate-y-[-2px], shadow-md, darken background).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). CRITICAL: DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.chat: Smooth staggered entrance for AI Health Chat messages. Typing indicator animations.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast calculator standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-pill-btn', data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.forms: Clear error states and high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2).

components.general: Use .js and .jsx files for all components. Rely on Shadcn UI primitives customized via Tailwind.
components.chat_interface: Custom implementation leveraging Shadcn ScrollArea. Stream UI for AI medical advice with a prominent 'Download Report' button.
components.pill_identification: Drag-and-drop zone for photo upload. Card overlay to display AI-identified pill details and instructions.
components.charts: Shadcn Chart / Recharts for biometric trend charts. Ensure color-blind-friendly palettes for data lines.
components.toasts: Use Sonner (located at /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js if applicable) for missed dose alerts and dose confirmations.
components.calendars: Shadcn Calendar for Medication schedule and adherence tracking.
components.dependents_management: Avatar lists and profile cards with clear hierarchy for switching active patient profiles.

media.strategy: Use real human moments for the landing page, clean high-contrast UI for the medical portal.

hero_landing.description: Doctor showing a patient something on the tablet - representing modern AI healthcare integration for the landing page.

pill_placeholder.description: Pills on hand - to be used as a visual placeholder or background for the pill identification upload feature.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all frontend logic using modern Javascript (ES6+) and React JSX.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui before building custom ones.
Build the dashboard using Recharts for vitals and biometric trends. Layout data densely but clearly.
For the AI Chat, ensure clear distinction between User and AI messages, and include an option to 'Download Report'.
Implement the doctor portal with data tables showing patient alerts and adherence reports.
Adhere strictly to the 'Organic & Earthy' color palette. DO NOT fallback to default Tailwind/Vercel styling.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Create layered depth with appropriate styling.
Never use dark colors as gradients. Keep surfaces solid and grounded.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Never use AI emojis (🤖🧠) for icons. Use lucide-react exclusively for vector iconography.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure every header, dropdown, or overlay has a solid or blurred background. NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds over content.
